title: StreamEnd
$comment: Role: the authoritative terminal record of a stream (docs/architecture.md §3.1; ocai/chat/types/stream.py StreamEnd) in omit-absent wire form, carried by the streamStop chunk (chat_chunk.schema.json `end` lane). Its usage/finish override any mid-stream updates in the fold, and `report` is the stream's FidelityReport — the streaming path's ONE report home, mirroring CallResult.report on the blocking path. This file also hosts the serialized-report $defs (fidelityReport, edgeReport, hostEffectReport, fieldLoss, semanticShift) mirroring ocai/core/fidelity.py; the report's `path`, `lossless`, `cost`, and `total_cost` members are DERIVED views recomputed on replay, never trusted from data.
description: The stream's terminal record: the final consumption and stop records, and the fidelity account of the stream's conversion legs.

usage.description: The final consumption record, when reported; authoritative over mid-stream usage chunks.

finish.description: The final stop record, when reported; authoritative over mid-stream finish chunks.

report.description: The fidelity account of the stream's conversion legs (request leg + transducer flush reports + fold losses).

fidelityReport.$comment: ocai/core/fidelity.py FidelityReport.to_dict — path/lossless/total_cost are derived from graph and host findings and recomputed on replay; path uses only edges.
fidelityReport.description: The accumulated graph and host-effect account; host records are not graph traversal.

path.description: The ordered node labels visited (`provider/interface@tag#shape`), derived from the edge records.

lossless.description: Whether the whole conversion preserved all information — derived, never asserted.

total_cost.description: The summed diagnostic cost across every traversed edge; derived.

edges.description: One edge report per traversed edge, in traversal order.

hosts.description: Actual host effects in insertion order, separate from declarations and qualification. Omitted when empty.

edgeReport.$comment: ocai/core/fidelity.py EdgeReport.to_dict — `cost` is derived from the loss records and recomputed on replay.
edgeReport.description: The losses and shifts incurred by traversing one conversion edge.

note.description: A human-readable description of the edge's conversion.

cost.description: The summed diagnostic severity across this edge's losses; derived.

losses.description: The per-field records this edge emitted, in order.

shifts.description: The semantics-level records this edge emitted, in order.

hostEffectReport.description: Actual host effects with adapter and declaration identity; not a graph edge or certification verdict.

phase.description: Open execution phase code, initially request or response.

cost.description: Derived diagnostic severity, never planner weight.

fieldLoss.$comment: ocai/core/fidelity.py FieldLoss.to_dict — a plain value object (no IR envelope).
fieldLoss.description: One field-level record of what a conversion edge did to a field.

path.description: A dotted/bracketed path to the field (e.g. "messages[0].parts[2].args_json").

disposition.description: The open code for what happened to the field. Known canonical values: exact, renamed, approximated, emulated, extensions, dropped, unsupported. An unrecognized code decodes conservatively (a replayed report may overstate loss, never understate it).

severity.description: A diagnostic information-cost weight (0.0 == lossless); a report view, never the planner weight.

note.description: A human-readable explanation of the mapping or the loss.

semanticShift.$comment: ocai/core/fidelity.py SemanticShift.to_dict — a plain value object (no IR envelope).
semanticShift.description: A semantics-level divergence record, distinct from field mapping.

kind.description: The open shift-kind code. Known canonical values: relocation, emulation, id_regenerated, range_passthrough; plugin-minted kinds are namespaced. Unknown values are legal and preserved verbatim.

path.description: A dotted/bracketed path to the affected location, when one is identifiable.

note.description: A human-readable explanation of the divergence.
